description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotency of the request. The value must be unique across different requests and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
修改方式，可选值：

- Cover（默认）：使用ips参数的值覆盖原白名单的IP地址。

- Append：在原白名单的IP地址中增加ips参数中输入的IP地址。

- Delete：在原白名单的IP地址中删除ips参数中输入的IP地址，至少需要保留一个IP地址。
description.en:
The modification mode. Valid values:

- Cover (default): overwrites the IP addresses in the original whitelist with the value of the ips parameter.

- Append: adds the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter to the original whitelist.

- Delete: removes the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter from the original whitelist. At least one IP address must be retained.

title.zh: 修改实例的VPC私网访问白名单
title.en: Modify the VPC internal-facing access whitelist of an instance

descriptions.zh:
## 注意事项
- 当实例状态为生效中（activating）、失效（invalid）和冻结（inactive）时，无法更新信息。
- 您可以通过两种方式更新白名单：IP白名单列表和IP白名单组。两种方式不能同时使用，且除了InstanceId和clientToken外，两种方式支持配置的参数也不同，具体如下： 
    - IP白名单列表：esIPWhitelist
    - IP白名单组：modifyMode、whiteIpGroup
- 公网访问白名单不支持配置私网IP地址，私网访问白名单不支持配置公网IP地址。
descriptions.en:
## Before you begin
- You cannot update information when the instance status is activating, invalid, or freeze (inactive).
- You can update the whitelist in two ways: IP whitelist list and IP whitelist group. The two methods cannot be used at the same time, and they support different parameters besides InstanceId and clientToken. The details are as follows: 
    - IP whitelist list: esIPWhitelist
    - IP whitelist group: modifyMode, whiteIpGroup
- The public access whitelist does not support private network IP addresses, and the internal-facing access whitelist does not support public IP addresses.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch update-white-ips --instance-id es-cn-npk2154oi000b0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --modify-mode Cover --es-ip-whitelist 10.61.xx.xx --white-ip-group '{"groupName":"test_group","whiteIpType":"PRIVATE_ES","ips":["10.2.xx.xx"]}' --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
